author: Matt Wolfe
description:
The biggest AI update this week isn't a new model, it's a new interface.

This week, pretty much every major AI company—OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google—rolled out major UI updates.

But the one that stood out most to me? OpenAI's Codex.

It's really starting to become an AI “super app.”

Here’s what changed:
💻 It can now control your computer (click, type, navigate)
💡 Run tasks in the background while you keep working
🏞️ Generate images directly inside the app
🔨 Build apps → test them → and even use them for you

Feels like we’re getting closer to that “one app that does everything” faster than expected.

Would you use this "super app"? 👇

#AI #Ainews #Codex #OpenAI #AiAgent
title: Testing Out OpenAI's New "Super App"
